# One tile of tall grass: a dark turf block 0.85 m square and 0.16 m tall with shaggy tufts on
# top, origin at its centre on the ground. The game places one per lawn tile and hides it when cut.
# Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Turf --base-color 0.098 0.239 0.247 --no-slot
material new Tuft --base-color 0.196 0.451 0.271 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Turf --size 1 --location 0.0000 0.0000 0.0800
scale 0.8300 0.8300 0.1600
apply --scale
material assign Turf
add mesh cone --name Tuft0 --vertices 4 --radius1 0.109 --radius2 0 --depth 0.166 --location -0.220 -0.200 0.230 --rotation -2 -8 6
material assign Tuft
add mesh cone --name Tuft1 --vertices 4 --radius1 0.116 --radius2 0 --depth 0.215 --location 0.180 -0.240 0.230 --rotation 7 6 20
material assign Tuft
add mesh cone --name Tuft2 --vertices 4 --radius1 0.121 --radius2 0 --depth 0.177 --location 0.000 0.020 0.230 --rotation -8 -9 19
material assign Tuft
add mesh cone --name Tuft3 --vertices 4 --radius1 0.137 --radius2 0 --depth 0.210 --location -0.240 0.220 0.230 --rotation 7 7 17
material assign Tuft
add mesh cone --name Tuft4 --vertices 4 --radius1 0.112 --radius2 0 --depth 0.198 --location 0.220 0.200 0.230 --rotation 6 9 79
material assign Tuft
add mesh cone --name Tuft5 --vertices 4 --radius1 0.103 --radius2 0 --depth 0.196 --location 0.270 -0.020 0.230 --rotation 4 0 16
material assign Tuft
add mesh cone --name Tuft6 --vertices 4 --radius1 0.119 --radius2 0 --depth 0.165 --location -0.050 0.300 0.230 --rotation 10 9 49
material assign Tuft
add mesh cone --name Tuft7 --vertices 4 --radius1 0.112 --radius2 0 --depth 0.215 --location -0.300 -0.020 0.230 --rotation 2 9 76
material assign Tuft
select Tuft0 Tuft1 Tuft2 Tuft3 Tuft4 Tuft5 Tuft6 Tuft7
active Tuft0
join
select Turf
active Turf
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select all
shade flat
export tuft.glb
